title: DALEX NonTox PAGE Stain
author: David Frommholz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v42e8ye

steps.title: Remove gel and wash
steps.instruction: Remove the gel from the cassette and place it into a tray (e.g., a weighing pan). Immerse the gel in distilled water (50 mL for an 8 × 8 cm gel) and microwave for 30 s at 500 W, then incubate with gentle shaking for 5 min and discard the water. Repeat the immersion, microwave, and shaking cycle two more times (total three washes). Note: Native PAGE gels do not contain SDS, so the washing step can be omitted for native gels.

steps.title: Add stain and microwave
steps.instruction: Add DALEX NonTox PAGE Stain enough to completely cover the gel (25 mL for an 8 × 8 cm gel). Microwave the gel with stain for 10 s at 500 W.

steps.title: Incubate with gentle swirling
steps.instruction: Incubate the stained gel with gentle swirling or rocking for at least 15 minutes, or until the desired staining intensity is reached.

steps.title: Remove stain and rinse
steps.instruction: Pour off the staining solution and rinse the gel with water twice. To increase contrast, the background can be further reduced by washing the gel in water and heating it in a microwave as described in step 1.
